description: Abstract task creation and collaboration framework using Dart as human frontend and git workspace repos as LLM-consumable backend

required.name: Dart workspace access
required.description: Dart workspace with board access. Canonical automation path is the REST API client (tools/dart-integration/lib/dart-api.js) authenticated via DART_TOKEN from env, the 1Password Automation vault item DART, or macOS Keychain; writes pass the Mythos identity gate (ensureWriteIdentity). A connected Dart MCP session is an optional human-frontend/auth surface and is not required for programmatic task creation.

required.name: Workspace repo
required.description: Git repo following Mythos workspace pattern with tasks/index.json

optional.name: Dart MCP session
optional.description: Optional connected Dart MCP session for human-frontend auth. As of 2026-05-29 the connected MCP surface exposes only authenticate/complete_authentication (no task CRUD); programmatic CRUD runs through the REST client above.

optional.name: config/client.json
optional.description: Client identity metadata in workspace repo

directories.description: Context files linked from Dart task footers
